Select molecule ChEMBL ID, name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in the specified document. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5260833. Return all columns with exact aliases molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
